textures.role: Packed soil in road centres and the village square
Weathered mineral faces on old ruins, waystones and rubble
Clover and dry grass on verges and village ground

visual_scope: Native third-person world and material closeups; no HUD in this isolated renderer

native_capture.warning: Xvfb driver cannot change V-Sync mode

visual_review.packed_dirt: Fine small-stone surface at authored 1.8m repeat; road centre remains visually distinct with a soft meadow boundary.
visual_review.meadow: Clover and dry-grass detail visible at close range; texture recedes without a hard material border from normal third-person camera.
visual_review.pebble_gravel: Revised tile removes conspicuous duplicated internal cluster. No obvious dark grid seam observed in normal town view or the supplied closeup. Some repeating individual stones can still be found when inspecting closeup; no claim of perfectly invisible tiling.
visual_review.cracked_stone: Rough grey mineral colour is applied to ruin walls, broken rubble, waystones and obelisks using world triplanar projection. Light and shadow preserve shape legibility.
visual_review.scope: This is a focused material integration check. Existing NPC proxy art and geometric scene limitations are not changed or represented as finished AAA art.
